title: PC-CROP Federal Accounting — Connection Center BFF read path
purpose: Expose the already-implemented server-authoritative Connection Center read models through the existing accounting BFF allowlist without opening any connection mutation. This is plumbing for the self-service UI required by section 22 and section 53.
boundaries: Only GET accounting/connections and GET accounting/connections/attestations are added to the BFF allowlist.
No POST connection/attestation path is exposed through the BFF in this slice.
The BFF remains stateless, no-cache, redirect-refusing and explicit-allowlist only.
No provider status is invented and no write can set a green connection tick.
No settings page, API mutation, Prisma, auth, 1C, EDO vendor, hosting or production mutation.
Merge and green CI are not production acceptance.
